description:
Joe is joined by mixed martial artists John Rallo, Matt Serra, and Din Thomas.

John Rallo owns Shogun Fights and is the owner and head coach at Ground Control Mixed Martial Arts Academy.

https://www.groundcontrolbaltimore.com
https://www.shogunfights.com

Matt Serra is a mixed martial artist and host of “UFC Unfiltered” with Jim Norton and “Geeking Out with Matt Serra.” He is the owner and an instructor at Serra BJJ.

https://www.youtube.com/@MattSerraBJJ
https://www.serrabjjacademy.com

Din Thomas is a mixed martial arts analyst, actor, and host of “Din Thomas’ Fight Court.”

https://www.youtube.com/@FightCourt
